note: PROPOSED, NOT FROZEN. Reuses frozen ErrorCode values; message_key values are module-owned.

rows.when: Identity header present; rejected by shared transport.
No server-derived session.
Correction without ever asserting 2FA (proposed; see review-decisions item 5).
Correction with 2FA older than 300s (proposed).
Actor lacks permission or is not the assigned/substitute teacher for that dated period.
Absent or other-school session/entry/student. Never 403 for cross-school.
expected_version mismatch.
Saving entries on a submitted session; corrections use the corrections path.
Submit when session is already submitted (idempotent retry with same key returns existing; without key / different body is conflict).
Create/save/submit against holiday, cancelled period, or ineligible teaching authority.
Trusted roster/timetable version diverged from session snapshot; reconciliation required.
Effective teacher assignment/substitution no longer authorises this actor at submit time.
Correction against an entry whose session is still draft.
Malformed body or unknown field (closed schemas).
Body carried school_id/actor_id/auth_level/grant.
Entry names an enrolment absent from the period's subject-filtered roster snapshot.
Save/submit includes status unmarked; unmarked is the absence of a mark, not a writable status on save.
Submit while any roster pupil lacks a non-unmarked status.
Correction missing a non-empty reason.
Status not in present|absent|late|excused (corrections) or save entries.
Submit without Idempotency-Key header.
Summary from>to or unbounded range.
timetable_session_id not returned by Timetable for this school (also surfaces as 404 when indistinguishable).
